description:
This process begins with identifying an employee's development needs or career aspirations.
The manager and HR create a personal development plan, which may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.
The employee keeps working on skill enhancement while receiving feedback and evaluation from supervisors.
Once certain milestones are reached, the employee is considered for a promotion or new role.
HR conducts a formal review of performance, and if approved, the promotion is finalized with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments.
The process ends when the employee is promoted and transitions into the new role.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Development" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeeds" name="Development needs or career aspirations identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToPlan</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Manager and HR create personal development plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToPlan</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlanToParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Continue development and evaluation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlanToParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToSkillEnhancement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Employee enhances skills">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToSkillEnhancement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkillEnhancementToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Supervisors provide feedback and evaluation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Development and evaluation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkillEnhancementToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToMilestones</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Milestones" name="Milestones reached?" default="Flow_MilestonesNotReached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToMilestones</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MilestonesReached</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MilestonesNotReached</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MilestonesReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConsiderationToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FormalReview" name="HR conducts formal performance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConsiderationToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalizeToTransition</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionRole" name="Employee transitions into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalizeToTransition</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TransitionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TransitionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not finalized">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToPlan" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreatePlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSkillEnhancement" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkillEnhancementToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToMilestones" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Milestones"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Milestones" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">milestonesReached</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesNotReached" name="Milestones not yet reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Milestones" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderationToReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_FormalReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToApproval" sourceRef="Task_FormalReview" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">promotionApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalizeToTransition" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_TransitionRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransitionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TransitionRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
